articles.title: South Korea joins more than 30 jurisdictions restricting Polymarket access
articles.snippet: Regulators rejected Polymarket's defense regarding its P2P nature, arguing the platform manages market rules and facilitates crypto-based gambling activity.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward joins Anthropic’s Project Glasswing for AI security push
articles.snippet: Payward will use Anthropic’s cybersecurity model to hunt vulnerabilities and share open-source findings.

articles.title: BitMart founder dismisses calls for audit as users report blocked funds, unpaid employees
articles.snippet: Sheldon Lee said a Chinese-language X account making the claims was hacked. Users want wallets, assets and liabilities disclosed.

articles.title: Bitcoin tags $65K as S&P 500 rebounds from 2-week lows on US-Iran rhetoric
articles.snippet: Bitcoin returned to $65,000 for the first time in a week as fresh BTC price volatility accompanied US claims that the Strait of Hormuz was “open and operating.”
